mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 7.5% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors anticipate tighter labor markets reducing inflationary pressures and boosting equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 7.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE crosses above 7.5% but 20-day returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) or the rise is temporary.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and rise in GDPC1 (demand growth) create a dual accommodative signal, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as markets anticipate sustained economic expansion.
failure_condition: Proxies move in opposite directions or their combined effect does not correlate with returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, sustained growth in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate prolonged economic activity and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth occurs in non-late-cycle regimes or fails to drive returns above baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS below 6,000 (thousands) signals tight labor markets, prompting equity purchases and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate reduced inflation and stronger growth.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS drops below 6000 in the next month
failure_condition: PAYEMS drops below 6000 but returns remain negative or fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) alongside INDPRO (supply growth) creates a dual signal of robust demand and inflationary pressures, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as markets anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: Proxies move inversely or their combined effect does not correlate with returns (Rank IC < 0.03 over 20 days).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a sustained drop in UNRATE below 5% predicts positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate labor market normalization and economic stability.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% in non-recovery regimes or fails to drive returns above baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in INDPRO (supply growth) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings and demand.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but returns remain negative or fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) over the 60-day period.
